restoretrustwallet.com.summary: Large cluster of fake TrustWallet, MetaMask, and crypto wallet phishing domains used for seed-phrase theft and fraudulent airdrops.

site-oficial-havan.online.summary: Fake clone website impersonating Brazilian retailer Havan (site-oficial-havan.online) used for phishing/scam.
